{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden has made fighting the trafficking of fentanyl a top priority.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Record amounts of fentanyl have been seized at the U.S. border.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More individuals have been arrested for fentanyl-related crimes in the last two years than in the previous five years combined.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Funding has been secured for more cutting-edge inspection machines to help detect fentanyl at the southwest border.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued an Executive Order to go after the global illicit fentanyl trade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sanctions have been imposed on some 300 persons and entities as a result of the Executive Order.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has continued working with Mexico to extradite and prosecute key fentanyl traffickers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Bilateral cooperation on counternarcotics with China has resumed after being stalled since 2019.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of fentanyl-related deaths has started to decline for the first time in five years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In his second term, President Biden will work with Congress to deploy more cutting-edge inspection machines to help detect fentanyl at U.S. ports of entry.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In his second term, President Biden will leverage all resources of the federal government to stop tech platforms from being used for criminal conduct, including sales of dangerous drugs like fentanyl.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
